name: Conrad Tokyo
positioning: Waterfront hotel in central Tokyo that pairs Conrad Hotels' standing with modern Japanese design, with views over Hamarikyu Gardens and Tokyo Bay
best_for: Travelers who want a central Tokyo base within walking distance of Ginza
Guests who want bay and garden views plus a spa, indoor pool and fitness area

facts.text: Conrad Tokyo is on the waterfront in central Tokyo, within walking distance of Ginza and Shinbashi.
The hotel's concept is a fusion of Conrad Hotels' standing with modern Japanese design.
Suigetsu Spa & Fitness custom-makes treatments, including courses using Japanese ingredients and treatments for men.
The fitness area has a gym with up-to-date machines, a studio, a sauna and a jet bath.
Conrad Tokyo has four restaurants and one bar and lounge.
The hotel offers a dog-friendly stay plan called Paws of Luxury.
Conrad Tokyo received four stars in both the Hotel and Spa categories of the Forbes Travel Guide 2026.

highlights.text: Windows look out over Hamarikyu Gardens, Tokyo Bay and the Rainbow Bridge.
The fitness area has an indoor pool with a sumi-e ink painting motif.
The Executive Lounge is on the hotel's top floor, overlooking Tokyo Bay and Hamarikyu Gardens.
The TwentyEight bar and lounge has 8-meter-high windows looking out on Tokyo Bay.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's upscale positioning.
WhataHotel notes the business-district location may feel less traditional than other Tokyo areas.
